title: C-FAITH: A Chinese Fine-Grained Benchmark for Automated Hallucination Evaluation
reasoning: The name 'C-FAITH' is an acronym for the hallucination benchmark. The paper focuses exclusively on evaluating factual hallucination types in large language models (such as factual fabrication, entity errors, and spatiotemporal errors) across domains like celebrities, biology, and culture, without any component evaluating religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
